generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the broadleaf base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the broadleaf program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Abrams and Ferris's Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States, volume 4 (1960), read in full: corolla campanulate, funnelform or tubular, 5-lobed and commonly two-lipped; anther-bearing stamens 2 or 4 on the corolla tube; ovary mostly 2-celled. Plants of the World Online (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read): flowers hypogynous, ovary superior; the fifth stamen usually a staminode.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 239 Bignoniaceae: trees or shrubs, sometimes climbing, very rarely herbs; leaves opposite, rarely alternate, mostly compound; stipules absent; fruit a capsule, or fleshy and not opening.
